official_documentation.name: Anthropic: The new rules of context engineering for Claude 5 generation models
official_documentation.description: Primary source (Thariq, Claude Code team, 2026-07-24): ~80% of Claude Code's system prompt removed for Claude 5-gen models (Opus 5, Fable 5) with no eval loss. Six shifts: rules->judgment, examples->interface design, upfront->progressive disclosure, repetition->single tool-description home, manual CLAUDE.md->auto-memory, markdown specs->rich references (HTML/code/rubrics). Recommends lightweight CLAUDE.md (gotchas only), non-overconstraining skills, /doctor to rightsize context.

research_and_methods.name: Microsoft SkillOpt
research_and_methods.description: MIT framework that optimizes skill documents as trainable artifacts via a rollout -> reflect -> validate loop with bounded add/delete/replace edits accepted only on a strictly non-regressing held-out score. Source for the Edit Gate (regression rule) in references/skill-validation.md; methodology only, not vendored as a skill
